cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Restaged under messages-for-bill 135 (a registered count is enough): UNHCR finalised 4,056 new and 15,301 continuous registrations of refugees and asylum-seekers up to March 2024 (DZA-001). Nothing says refugees may use SIM cards, accounts or digital ID, so not 4.
